title: What tools you using to make your game
author: evertonuk
selftext: Im playing around with React and Phaser at the moment.

comments.author: Jolly_Roger-99
comments.body:
Im started a few weeks ago with cursor for coding and chatgpt for talking about how i want to make stuff and for explanation and Research - its more a learning Projekt for godot. Its a small RTS.

Prototype looks good so far, and it is playabel.  now im struggeling with the assets.
First i build a local asset pupeline in comfyUI - which works i guess, at least i can generate pictures and make them to a 3d Mesh - however for texturing my hardware is too old. And im not happy with the results, the style is not consistent enough, it may be a prompt problem, Not sure.

I tried ludoAI because it offers sound too but the Animation for spider creatures are not working.

So guess this weekend is planned for getting working assets.

If anyone have a tipp for easy asset making i would aprreciate that.

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body:
cursor for code. 

grok bot for website, management of random pc issues, random tasks.

grok image for images.

photoshop for image editing.

godot for engine. 

vectorizer.ai for vectorization.

elevenlabs for music.

openart.ai for trailer.

itch.io, epic and unity for asset stores like sfx.

youtube shorts, discord for promotion.

steam for selling.
